regions.today: Mostly cloudy in the north of the province, with sunny spells elsewhere. Light to moderate northerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight but mostly cloudy. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 11 degrees in a light to moderate northerly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: A generally cloudy start tomorrow, with the best of any early sunshine in the south. Sunny spells will become more widespread through the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 21 to 23 degrees, in light, occasionally moderate, northerly breezes.
